top_signals.title: China Sells Long-Dated Offshore Yuan Bonds at Record Low Yields
top_signals.summary: China sold long-dated yuan-denominated sovereign bonds in Hong Kong at record-low yields, underscoring strong demand from global investors for the offshore issuance.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
